deadline.value: No fixed deadline: positions are advertised when available, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: Available positions are advertised when available on the departmental website

supervisor.value: Students are hired into a scientist's project and that scientist acts as supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Research topics are most often defined by scientists from our department who hire you for their project and act as your supervisor during your studies.

funding.value: Students are hired by project leaders, i.e. employed for the project.
funding.quote: who hire you for their project and act as your supervisor during your studies

entry_route.value: A second-cycle degree, or 240 credits with 60 at second level, plus 30 credits of independent work in geosciences.
entry_route.quote: must have completed a second-cycle degree, completed courses equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be in the second cycle

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Geology, Geochemistry and Marine Geology. Physical Geography and Meteorology also run PhDs but were not researched.
